title: L1-inception-task-generator-evaluator Output
description: Full AgentOutput envelope. content.items.verification_results holds one independently-rejudged entry per task the generator produced (structural fields stay full: ids, booleans, hours). content.items.feature_coverage holds one entry per input feature, catching silently-dropped features. content.items.fixes_applied lists any correction made to items and/or the artifact. content.verdict is the overall pass/fail call. If a fix touched the document, content.artifacts[0] carries the SAME artifact id and storage location as the generator's, re-uploaded — never a new artifact.

workflow_execution_id.description: MUST match the workflow_execution_id of the generator_output being evaluated.

verification_results.description: One entry per task_id present in generator_output.content.items.tasks.

feature_coverage.description: One entry per feature in the original features input — catches features silently dropped from both tasks and gaps.

guardrail_rechecks.description: Independent re-check of each BLOCKER-relevant guardrail the generator owns — never a copy of the generator's own pass/fail claim.

final_decision.description: 'fixed_and_approved' MUST NOT be reported while the artifact still holds pre-fix text.

hallucination_score.description: Lower is better — rate of unsupported/invented tasks or scope found.

consistency_score.description: Rate of tasks whose type/effort/dependencies correctly follow kb-L1-task-decomposition-best-practices.

artifacts.description: Present ONLY if a fix touched the document. Same artifact id and storage.location as the generator's — re-uploaded, not a new artifact.

source_reference.description: e.g. 'features.json' or 'acceptance-criteria.json' — the ORIGINAL source, re-checked independently, not the generator's citation copied verbatim.

task_type_justified.description: True if this task type is independently justified by the feature's description/acceptance criteria per the KB's selection rule.

effort_within_ceiling.description: False if generator_effort_hours exceeds max_task_effort_hours and no split was documented.

dependency_correct.description: True if blocks_task_ids/blocked_by_task_ids independently match the KB's dependency-inference patterns for this task's role.

duplicate_flag_verified.description: Present only when adjacent_backlog_check=true; result of an independent tool-L1-jira-fetch-issue call, not the generator's stored flag.

match.description: True only if task_type_justified AND effort_within_ceiling AND dependency_correct are all true.

summary.description: Distilled finding. Full reasoning for a mismatch lives in its paired fixes_applied entry, never restated here.

covered.description: True if this feature has >=1 task in generator_output OR a gap entry the evaluator judges legitimate.

task_ids.description: Task ids generated for this feature, if any.

gap_legitimate.description: Present only if the generator reported this feature as a gap; whether that gap holds up against the KB's 'when a feature can't be decomposed' criteria.

ref_id.description: The task_id (or feature_id, for a newly-inserted task) this fix applies to.

generator_value.description: Stringified original value for a uniform diff view.

document_updated.description: True if this field also appears in task-breakdown.md and was corrected there at the same location.

id.description: MUST equal the generator's artifact id — this is a re-upload, not a new artifact.

location.description: MUST equal the generator's storage.location — same {workflow_execution_id}/task-breakdown.md path.
